title: Wheel-like Gd42 polynuclear complexes with significant magnetocaloric effect

synthesis.procedure: Gadolinium acetate was added to a solution of 3-methoxysalicylaldehyde in methanol, followed by triethylamine solution in ethanol. The mixture was stirred under reflux for 40 minutes, cooled, filtered, and subjected to diffusion with methyl tert-butyl ether. Pale yellow bulk crystals formed after about 10 days; they were collected, washed three times with methanol, and dried.
synthesis.temperature: reflux in methanol; then cooled to room temperature
synthesis.time: 40 minutes under reflux; approximately 10 days for crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred reflux followed by solvent diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered, diffused with methyl tert-butyl ether, collected, washed three times with methanol, and dried.

properties.summary: Weak ferromagnetic interactions were indicated by a positive Curie–Weiss temperature. The cluster exhibited a substantial magnetocaloric effect.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete, hollow wheel contains 42 Gd(III) ions arranged as fourteen repeated three-Gd structural units, linked by deprotonated O-vanillin, hydroxide, and acetate ligands. Its reported inner and outer diameters are approximately 1.5 and 3.6 nm.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the procedure reported for 1-Gd, replacing its gadolinium acetate with dysprosium acetate. Thus the acetate was reacted with 3-methoxysalicylaldehyde in methanol and triethylamine solution in ethanol under stirred reflux for 40 minutes; after cooling and filtration, methyl tert-butyl ether was diffused into the solution. Crystals were collected after approximately 10 days, washed with methanol, and dried.

reagents.name: triethylamine solution in ethanol
reagents.amount: 1.0 mol L−1, 1 mL; shared procedure for 1-Gd

synthesis.temperature: reflux in methanol; then cooled to room temperature, following the 1-Gd procedure
synthesis.time: 40 minutes under reflux; approximately 10 days for crystallization, following the 1-Gd procedure
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred reflux followed by solvent diffusion, following the 1-Gd procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered, diffused with methyl tert-butyl ether, collected, washed three times with methanol, and dried, following the 1-Gd procedure.

properties.summary: The Dy analogue showed magnetic anisotropy and a smaller magnetocaloric effect than 1-Gd. No out-of-phase AC susceptibility signal or slow magnetic relaxation was observed, even under an external DC field.
